evidence.quote: the aged C alloy exhibits a heterogeneous microstructure that consists of RR and NRR matrix, containing recrystallized grains, dislocation tangles, annealing twins, submicron σ phase precipitates, micron precipitates of the (Ti, W, Mo)-rich phase and nano γ’ precipitates.

evidence.quote: As trace Nb doped, the heterogeneous microstructure can be changed and improved, where the (Ti, Nb)-rich phase forms instead of (Ti, W, Mo)-rich phase, the γ’ phase precipitates in high density with ultra-fine size of 4 – 10 nm and the σ phase is refined.
